fusions.name: Full Draw
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow of arcana at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 32 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Spell Quiver
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows of arcana at once in a spread out to 8 tiles, each dealing 3 damage. It holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Far Mark
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Nocked and Waiting
fusions.desc: The moment your mana is full, your next spell deals 35% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
